test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

 V, U, R, M, ?, W, L, Y
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe9794e95a9d805a7ec5ced652fcd4eb7d1c44cdd4741e967e592e0cbdefeea8.png] 

Logic followed here is: The next letter in the series is determined by subtracting consecutive odd numbers (1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, ...) from the positional value of the previous letter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61073591b6de5d4dfd7872dcf92bfd7cbe246d47ce417ea5c51afbaf9a11100f.png] 

 

Therefore, the missing term in the series is 'F'.
